name: Expert_ADC_PL_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a custom CDC_PL_Stoch signal filter based on Stochastic oscillator combined with a moving average to generate trade entries and exits. It operates within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with fixed lot money management and no trailing stop. The signal threshold mechanism filters weak signals, only acting when the composite signal strength exceeds configurable open/close thresholds.
summary_zh: 该EA使用基于随机指标和移动平均线的自定义CDC_PL_Stoch信号过滤器来生成交易入场和出场信号。它在MQL5标准库专家框架内运行，采用固定手数资金管理，无跟踪止损。信号阈值机制过滤弱信号，仅在复合信号强度超过可配置的开仓/平仓阈值时才执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用随机指标（Stochastic）与移动平均线的组合信号进行动量交易。入场条件基于CDC_PL_Stoch过滤器生成的信号强度，当信号值超过开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，当信号值低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓。随机指标的K周期默认为47，D周期为9，慢速周期为13，价格应用方式为最高最低价，配合周期为5的移动平均线进行趋势确认。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认手数为0.1，风险百分比为10%，没有使用跟踪止损（CTrailingNone）。资金管理方面较为简单，固定手数不根据账户余额动态调整，缺乏自适应的风险控制机制。整体策略依赖信号阈值过滤来避免频繁交易，但缺少止损和止盈的显式设置（StopLevel和TakeLevel均为0），存在风险敞口过大的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA utilizes a combined signal from the Stochastic oscillator and a moving average for momentum-based trading. Entry conditions are based on the signal strength generated by the CDC_PL_Stoch filter, opening positions when the signal value exceeds the open threshold (default 40) and closing when it falls below the close threshold (default 20). The Stochastic indicator uses a K period of 47, D period of 9, slowing period of 13, applied to low/high prices, combined with a 5-period moving average for trend confirmation. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1 and a risk percentage of 10%, with no trailing stop employed (CTrailingNone). Money management is relatively simplistic as the fixed lot size does not dynamically adjust based on account balance, lacking adaptive risk control mechanisms. The overall strategy relies on signal threshold filtering to avoid excessive trading, but the absence of explicit stop loss and take profit settings (StopLevel and TakeLevel are both 0) exposes the strategy to potentially large risk.

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdOpen
parameters.description: 开仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度超过此值才开仓
parameters.description_en: Open signal threshold [0...100]; opens when exceeded

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdClose
parameters.description: 平仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度低于此值才平仓
parameters.description_en: Close signal threshold [0...100]; closes when below

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易的价格水平，0为市价执行
parameters.description_en: Trade execution price level; 0 = market price

parameters.name: Signal_StopLevel
parameters.description: 止损水平（点数），0表示未设置止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss level in points; 0 = no SL

parameters.name: Signal_TakeLevel
parameters.description: 止盈水平（点数），0表示未设置止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit level in points; 0 = no TP

parameters.name: Signal__StochApplied
parameters.description: 随机指标价格应用方式

pros: 基于MQL5标准库Expert框架开发，代码结构清晰规范，模块化程度高
随机指标结合移动平均线的双确认机制，有助于过滤假信号
信号阈值开仓/平仓机制提供了一定的信号质量过滤能力
使用非标准K周期(47)，可能在一定程度上避免与大众策略的共振
固定手数模式简化了仓位管理，适合初学者理解和调试
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, modular code structure
Dual confirmation mechanism combining Stochastic with moving average helps filter false signals
Signal threshold open/close mechanism provides signal quality filtering capability
Non-standard K period (47) may partially avoid resonance with commonly used strategies
Fixed lot model simplifies position sizing, suitable for beginners to understand and debug
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，缺乏基本的风险保护机制，可能导致单笔巨额亏损
固定手数资金管理无法根据账户规模和市场波动动态调整仓位
无跟踪止损，盈利头寸缺乏保护机制，可能面临利润大幅回吐
仅依赖单一信号过滤器，策略多样性不足，在震荡市中可能频繁亏损
缺少点差过滤、新K线检查等基本保护机制
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are both set to 0, lacking basic risk protection and potentially leading to catastrophic single-trade losses
Fixed lot money management cannot dynamically adjust position size based on account size or market volatility
No trailing stop means profitable positions lack protection, potentially suffering significant profit drawdowns
Relies on a single signal filter with insufficient strategy diversity, likely to suffer frequent losses in ranging markets
Missing basic protections such as spread filter and new bar check
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，设置合理的默认值以保护资金安全
引入动态仓位管理机制，根据账户余额和ATR指标调整交易手数
添加跟踪止损模块以锁定盈利，并增加点差过滤和新K线检查
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters with reasonable default values to protect capital
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR indicator for adaptive risk management
Add a trailing stop module to lock in profits, and implement spread filter and new bar check mechanisms

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，交易没有硬性风险边界，单笔亏损可能极大
无点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
无新K线检查机制，每个tick可能重复计算信号导致过度交易
固定手数不随账户变化，资金曲线下行时风险比例增大
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are both 0, trades have no hard risk boundaries and single-trade losses can be extremely large
No spread filter, may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No new bar check mechanism, every tick may recalculate signals leading to overtrading
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account changes, risk ratio increases during equity drawdowns
